visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a dark grey hoodie and black pants and a young woman in a beige hoodie, white leggings, and black shorts are seen outdoors at night in a deep squatting position. They are positioned in a festive urban plaza with a large, illuminated blue Christmas tree behind them. The woman initially holds a smartphone, looking down at the screen, while the man looks toward her with a neutral expression. The setting is decorated with string lights and kiosks. (2) The woman puts her phone down and brings her hands together in a prayer pose, resting her elbows on her knees. Both individuals maintain the squatting posture as a timer overlay at the bottom progresses. They begin to look at each other, smiling and eventually laughing, showing signs of mutual interaction and amusement. Passersby in winter clothing move through the background. (3) As the timer surpasses one minute and forty seconds, the couple remains in the same squatting position. They exhibit slight physical swaying but continue to laugh and talk to each other, maintaining a playful and high-energy interaction. The surrounding environment remains consistent with bright festive lighting and several background figures walking past.
